traits.name: Fey Step
traits.text:
The Count is unaffected by difficult
terrain.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.text:
Magic cannot put the Count
to sleep.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text:
The Count has advantage
on saving throws against spells and other
magical effects.

traits.name: Command Fey
traits.text: As a member of the Court of Arcadia, the Count can cast dominate monster (DC 13) at will on any fey creature or elf.

traits.name: Now You See Me…
traits.text:
If the Count teleports next
to an enemy, he immediately makes two rapier
attacks with advantage against that enemy.

traits.name: Tactical Advantage
traits.text:
If the Count has advantage
on an attack roll, he deals an extra 7
(2d6) damage.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text: The Count’s innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). He can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: * At will: misty step, hunter’s mark * 3/day: blur, mirror image

actions.name: Rapier
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5
ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.text:
Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit,
range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4)
piercing damage.
